exception_scope: Only the two original exact build/lint dependency paths. Eight propagated High entries from one advisory. No broader paths, altered ranges, new finding or runtime exposure is covered.
exception_expires: 2026-11-04T00:00:00Z or immediately when an installable patched braces release exists
fix_available_interpretation: Exact unchanged ancestor flags recommend major downgrades to eslint-config-next 14.2.35 or vinext 0.0.15; they do not identify a patched braces release.

sharp_remediation.scope: Existing exact Release 49 global 0.35.5 override retained; fresh production audit is authoritative for current findings.

runtime_exposure_scan.method: Static, side-effect and dynamic import/require scan of application/Worker/Edge runtime plus top-level proxy/middleware/instrumentation, all built JS and JSON/sourcemap module markers including escaped Windows paths; packaged node_modules is rejected.

primary_sources.observation_method: Fresh direct official GitHub-reviewed advisory read via web tool; recorded immediately after relevant identity, severity, affected and patch fields were observed.

primary_sources.observed: Parent-provided official registry receipt is hash-bound here. This verifier makes no network request.

limitations: This strict gate applies to this source/lock/runtime artifact and fresh raw audit snapshot only. The import/source-marker scan is a static heuristic, not exhaustive proof that transformed bundled code contains no affected implementation. Exact locked build/lint-only paths and fresh production audit complement that scan. Build/lint High findings remain an explicitly bounded historical exception, not a zero-full-audit claim. Later source/artifact/input changes require revalidation; all other release gates remain separate.
